record.paper_title: Noncommutative spectral geometry of Riemannian foliations: some results and open problems
record.original_question: For a compact Riemannian manifold (M, g), let Phi_t(T) = exp(i t sqrt(Delta_g)) T exp(-i t sqrt(Delta_g)) act on the completed pseudodifferential algebra Psi-bar^0(M), and let F_t be the classical geodesic flow on the cosphere bundle S^*M. Can one define a quantum topological entropy h(Phi_t) for this noncommutative geodesic flow in a way that is meaningfully related to the classical topological entropy h(F_t)?

evidence.quote: Consider the one-parameter group Phi_t of *-automorphisms of the C^*-algebra Psi-bar^0(M) defined as Phi_t(T) = e^{it sqrt(Delta_g)} T e^{-it sqrt(Delta_g)}, T in Psi-bar^0(M), where Delta_g is the Laplace operator associated with g. Let F_t denote the geodesic flow on the cosphere bundle S^*M...
Problem 4.4. To define a quantum topological entropy h(Phi_t) of the noncommutative geodesic flow Phi_t so that it is related with the classical topological entropy h(F_t) of the geodesic flow F_t.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a compact Riemannian manifold without boundary, and let $\Delta_g$ denote the (positive) Laplace–Beltrami operator on $M$. Let $\Psi^0(M)$ be the algebra of classical pseudodifferential operators of order $0$ on $M$, and let $\overline{\Psi}^0(M)$ denote its norm closure in $\mathcal{B}(L^2(M))$, which is a unital $C^*$-algebra containing the compact operators. Define the one-parameter group $\{\Phi_t\}_{t\in\mathbb{R}}$ of $*$-automorphisms of $\overline{\Psi}^0(M)$ by
$$\Phi_t(T) = e^{it\sqrt{\Delta_g}}\, T\, e^{-it\sqrt{\Delta_g}}, \qquad T\in \overline{\Psi}^0(M).$$
On the cosphere bundle $S^*M = \{(x,\xi)\in T^*M : |\xi|_g = 1\}$, let $F_t : S^*M \to S^*M$ be the classical geodesic flow, and let $h(F_t)$ denote its classical topological entropy (in the sense of Adler–Konheim–McAndrew or Bowen).

Problem: Define a notion of quantum topological entropy $h(\Phi_t)$ for the noncommutative geodesic flow $\Phi_t$ acting on the $C^*$-algebra $\overline{\Psi}^0(M)$ such that $h(\Phi_t)$ is meaningfully related to the classical topological entropy $h(F_t)$ of the geodesic flow (for instance, by establishing an equality, inequality, or other explicit comparison between the two quantities for every compact Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$).
artifact.status_search_result: A literature search reveals related work on Egorov-type theorems for noncommutative geodesic flows on foliated manifolds and on classical topological entropy of geodesic flows, but no published result establishes a definition of quantum topological entropy of the automorphism group $\Phi_t = e^{it\sqrt{\Delta_g}} \cdot e^{-it\sqrt{\Delta_g}}$ on $\overline{\Psi}^0(M)$ explicitly tied to the classical geodesic-flow entropy $h(F_t)$. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Egorov's Theorem for Transversally Elliptic Operators on Foliated Manifolds and Noncommutative Geodesic Flow
status_evidence.snippet: Egorov's theorem relating the quantum evolution of transverse pseudodifferential operators to the classical evolution of their symbols.
status_evidence.claim: Related background on the noncommutative geodesic flow framework, but does not address quantum topological entropy.

status_evidence.title: Topological Entropy for Geodesic Flows
status_evidence.snippet: Classical results on topological entropy of geodesic flows on Riemannian manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the classical entropy side of the comparison; no quantum counterpart established.
